title: Palantir WEF participant resolution depth 4
summary: The recursive person-level search resolves Alex Karp as a named WEF Annual Meeting 2026 participant and session subject, while leaving AMNC 2026 Palantir participant attribution unresolved.

sources.title: A Spirit of Dialogue Brings Record Numbers of World Leaders to Davos for World Economic Forum Annual Meeting 2026
Conversation with Alex Karp, CEO and Co-Founder, Palantir Technologies

gaps: No primary-source result in this pass names a Palantir individual as a participant in the Annual Meeting of the New Champions 2026 specifically.
WEF profile pages for Shyam Sankar, Katherine Hsiao, Consuelo Remmert and Lisa Gordon establish WEF-hosted personnel profiles or council history, not participation in AMNC 2026.
caveats: Davos Annual Meeting 2026 and Annual Meeting of the New Champions 2026 are distinct meetings.

data.question: Which named Palantir personnel are directly documented in WEF 2026 meeting materials?
data.method: Primary-source WEF participant, session and profile search.
data.scope: Named Palantir personnel in 2026 WEF meeting materials, distinguishing Davos Annual Meeting from AMNC.
findings: WEF explicitly listed Alex Karp among technology and innovation leaders taking part in the Annual Meeting 2026.
WEF hosted a dedicated Conversation with Alex Karp session on January 20, 2026 from 15:00 to 15:30 CET.

WEF maintains current personnel profiles for Shyam Sankar, Consuelo Remmert, Katherine Hsiao and Lisa Gordon; Katherine Hsiao's profile additionally states prior service on WEF's Global Future Council for Data Policy.
No named Palantir AMNC 2026 participant was source-verified in this pass.
conclusions: Alex Karp is now a resolved person-level Palantir-to-WEF 2026 event link for Davos, but the AMNC 2026 partner listing remains unresolved at the individual-participant level.
limitations: Search-index coverage does not prove absence from unpublished or poorly indexed participant materials.
unresolved: Session-level role of any Palantir personnel at AMNC 2026
Whether other current Palantir WEF profile holders appeared at 2026 WEF meetings
